recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If Patient Care wants an explicit Condition-specific pointer to meta.lastUpdated, handle that as a new clarification request rather than unfinished work for this already-applied DSTU1 issue.
issue_request: FHIR-7615 was a Published Patient Care DSTU1 issue resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It objected that if Condition.dateAsserted was meant to capture first assertion, a sibling dateFirstAsserted should be added; the accepted change was instead to add a usage note explaining that the date represented when this particular record was created, not later severity, abatement, or other updates, and that last record modification could be found from resource metadata.
initial_application: Git commit c6b154ca1b0087117ef7b89610c4e862b5357af9 explicitly cited #7615 with #7855 and #7859. It renamed Condition.dateAsserted to Condition.dateRecorded in the then-current Condition spreadsheet and examples, changed the short/definition toward documented/recorded semantics, and added the requested created-not-last-update usage note. Later source migrations and resource evolution moved the current representation to Condition.recordedDate in source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini, so the current StructureDefinition source is build scope. Current recordedDate text says the condition was first recorded and defines the element as when this particular Condition record was created in the system. Later Published Patient Care issues FHIR-27808, FHIR-34392, and FHIR-34394 refined recordedDate with onset-boundary rationale, sending-system preservation, receipt-timestamp fallback, and the contrast with recorder as most recent author. FHIR-35113 later requested further assertedDate/recordedDate changes but was Resolved - No Change because the area had already been reviewed. Direct FHIR-7615 Confluence and Zulip searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Condition source already conveys the substance of FHIR-7615: recordedDate is about record creation/first recording, not subsequent clinical updates or most-recent authorship. Adding a local meta.lastUpdated sentence would restate general Resource metadata behavior without changing implementer understanding.
